## Type

- [ ] `source:` new or updated source record

## Checklist

- [ ] Fields taken from the live catalog entry; `Verification` date and `Evidence URL` filled
- [ ] Instrument type recorded (LFS / EHCVM / continuous HH module / other)
- [ ] No older round or other survey substituted for an unavailable latest round; gaps added to `flags.csv`
- [ ] `validate_metadata.py`, `check_no_microdata.py` and `build_source_matrix.py` run locally
- [ ] No microdata or respondent-level files included
